caption: The drawing depicts a headless and handless male figure dressed in an 18th-century style outfit. The outfit consists of a long, deep red coat with gold trim and decorative buttons along the front and cuffs. Underneath the coat, there is a white waistcoat with multiple buttons that are fastened up the front, and a white ruffled shirt collar is visible at the neckline. The figure is also wearing pale yellow breeches. The background is a plain, light tan color with no other objects or details present. The drawing style uses watercolor or ink, with shading and color gradients to depict the folds in the fabric and add dimension to the clothing.
